s0601.literal: Inner circuits suffered famine; one hundred thousand ingots of notes and fifty thousand shi of grain were granted in relief.
s0601.idiomatic: Inner circuits suffered famine; 100,000 ingots of notes and 50,000 shi of grain were granted in relief.

s0602.literal: Displaced persons from Hejian's various prefectures went to Tong and Huo prefectures seeking food; officials were ordered to succor and preserve them.
s0602.idiomatic: Displaced persons from Hejian's various prefectures went to Tong and Huo prefectures seeking food; officials were ordered to succor and preserve them.

s0603.literal: Hangzhou Route suffered fire; the poor were granted one month's relief grain.
s0603.idiomatic: Hangzhou Route suffered fire; the poor were granted 1 month's relief grain.

s0604.literal: Changde Route suffered flooding; the people were famine-stricken; eleven thousand six hundred shi of grain was granted in relief.
s0604.idiomatic: Changde Route suffered flooding; the people were famine-stricken; 11,600 shi of grain was granted in relief.

s0605.literal: Twelfth month, on wuyin day, Tash Temür was made central secretariat right chancellor.
s0605.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on wuyin day, Tash Temür was made central secretariat right chancellor.

s0606.literal: On guiwei day Tash Temür was additionally granted commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies, supreme pillar of state, recorder of state affairs of military importance, and overseer of the national history, and enfeoffed Duke of Ji State.
s0606.idiomatic: On guiwei day Tash Temür was additionally granted commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies, supreme pillar of state, recorder of state affairs of military importance, and overseer of the national history, and enfeoffed Duke of Ji State.

s0607.literal: Prince Busaiyin dispatched envoys presenting pearls; twenty thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0607.idiomatic: Prince Busaiyin dispatched envoys presenting pearls; 20,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0608.literal: On yiyou day the Emperor again received Buddhist precepts from the Imperial Preceptor.
s0608.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Emperor again received Buddhist precepts from the Imperial Preceptor.

s0609.literal: Mars transgressed Celestial River, and Mercury encroached upon Establishment Star.
s0609.idiomatic: Mars transgressed Celestial River, and Mercury encroached upon Establishment Star.

s0610.literal: On dinghai day Deer-top Hall was repaired.
s0610.idiomatic: On dinghai day Deer-top Hall was repaired.

s0611.literal: Prince of Zhennan Tobuhua died; central secretariat grand councillor Namadai was dispatched to administer garrison affairs at that place.
s0611.idiomatic: Prince of Zhennan Tobuhua died; central secretariat grand councillor Namadai was dispatched to administer garrison affairs at that place.

s0612.literal: Central Secretariat ministers said that Shandong, Shaanxi, and Huguang bordered barbarian peoples on their frontiers and requested deliberation on selecting imperial clansmen to garrison there — approved.
s0612.idiomatic: Central Secretariat ministers said that Shandong, Shaanxi, and Huguang bordered barbarian peoples on their frontiers and requested deliberation on selecting imperial clansmen to garrison there — approved.

s0613.literal: A renewed prohibition on prophetic charts and omens was issued; those who privately hoarded them without submitting them were punished.
s0613.idiomatic: A renewed prohibition on prophetic charts and omens was issued; those who privately hoarded them without submitting them were punished.

s0614.literal: On guisi day theft was rampant in the capital; Tash Temür requested execution of serious offenders, additional deployment of patrol guards, and establishment of a reward scale for capturing thieves — approved.
s0614.idiomatic: On guisi day theft was rampant in the capital; Tash Temür requested execution of serious offenders, additional deployment of patrol guards, and establishment of a reward scale for capturing thieves — approved.

s0615.literal: On jiawu day Venus encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.
s0615.idiomatic: On jiawu day Venus encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.

s0616.literal: Zhang Gui was summoned from Baoding.
s0616.idiomatic: Zhang Gui was summoned from Baoding.

s0617.literal: On dingyou day Niuzhe was promoted to privy council administrator; he and Ma'asha were both granted commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies.
s0617.idiomatic: On dingyou day Niuzhe was promoted to privy council administrator; he and Ma'asha were both granted commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies.

s0618.literal: The wine prohibition in Ruizhou Route was relaxed.
s0618.idiomatic: The wine prohibition in Ruizhou Route was relaxed.

s0619.literal: Left associate administrator Qizhu and Prince Ordoe'erhan campaigned against Yao bandits and defeated them.
s0619.idiomatic: Left associate administrator Qizhu and Prince Ordoe'erhan campaigned against Yao bandits and defeated them.

s0620.literal: Puzhan, native official of Yunnan Route, raided as a bandit; garrison troops were ordered to capture him.
s0620.idiomatic: Puzhan, native official of Yunnan Route, raided as a bandit; garrison troops were ordered to capture him.

s0621.literal: On renyin day Fengxiang Prefecture of Daning Route suffered famine; wine brewing was forbidden.
s0621.idiomatic: On renyin day Fengxiang Prefecture of Daning Route suffered famine; wine brewing was forbidden.

s0622.literal: Right associate administrator Zhao Jian requested implementation of the regional field system in inner circuits, and that Dong Wei's Song-dynasty compilation Book for Relieving Famine and Sustaining the People be promulgated to prefectures and counties.
s0622.idiomatic: Right associate administrator Zhao Jian requested implementation of the regional field system in inner circuits, and that Dong Wei's Song-dynasty compilation Book for Relieving Famine and Sustaining the People be promulgated to prefectures and counties.

s0623.literal: Jinan and Yanchuan routes suffered famine; three thousand five hundred ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0623.idiomatic: Jinan and Yanchuan routes suffered famine; 3,500 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

s0624.literal: Huizhou, Hangzhou, and other places suffered famine; grain was issued and sold at reduced prices in varying amounts.
s0624.idiomatic: Huizhou, Hangzhou, and other places suffered famine; grain was issued and sold at reduced prices in varying amounts.

s0625.literal: That year hail fell in Shaanxi Prefecture and the Imperial River overflowed.
s0625.idiomatic: That year hail fell in Shaanxi Prefecture and the Imperial River overflowed.

s0626.literal: Because the former Hanlin academician Buhua, Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Buyan Toq, and guard commander Buyanhuli had been imprisoned and put to death by Tieshi and his faction, meritorious subject titles together with rank, noble title, and posthumous name honors were posthumously conferred.
s0626.idiomatic: Because the former Hanlin academician Buhua, Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Buyan Toq, and guard commander Buyanhuli had been imprisoned and put to death by Tieshi and his faction, meritorious subject titles together with rank, noble title, and posthumous name honors were posthumously conferred.
